integrity: An explicit infinite proof via dyadic ball isometries and coset quotients is included; standalone code checks finite residue cases only.
scientific_limitations: Only dyadic closures for integer quartics X^4+cX^2 with odd c. The c = 7 (mod 8) case follows from prior simple-root criteria; the additional content is the exact subgroup classification in the three nonsplitting classes. No pointwise ratio-set classification or independent review is claimed.
title: Complete dyadic quotient-set closures for the quartics \(X^4+cX^2\)
